why: A record that is fresh in the site plan and stale in the layout graph. Every number in this `walk-record.json` is a real hash of a real gallery build: the plan hash and the blockout hash are this point's own, and the `layout_graph_sha256` is the site-plan overlay's — a different whole, with different beats, a different critical path and a different flag on its gated way, whose plan and whose derived massing nevertheless hash identically to this one. So the record names a walk that happened, of a map this is not, and every hash taken over GEOMETRY agrees that nothing moved. The whole a walk judges is derived from two authored documents and the plan is only one of them: a node's `size_class` is a sky-open box's headroom, a seam is cut to air or filled with the bar by its edge's `class`, the side an `anchor/unlock-…` stands on is its `opens_from`, and what a body must hold to pass is its `gating`. None of that is written in the plan. It declares no unit: every field these documents use is written in the site-plan overlay and compiles there, so there is nothing to exempt — what must not compile is detail work standing on a walk of a different whole.
